title: CAF — Coderium Agent Framework
description: A multi-agent framework I designed to automate the development process, from planning to deployment. 5-layer architecture: a structured knowledge base, 8 specialist agents following a Plan-Implement-Verify pattern, artifact handoff between agents, automated quality gates, and orchestration via Linear webhooks that trigger headless Claude Code on a VPS.

title: umkm-pos
description: A multi-tenant Point-of-Sale system for small-to-medium businesses, with an AI agent as the key differentiator. The core system (multi-tenant, real-time) is live, with a Product Input Agent, Daily Report Agent, and Stock Agent as the next development focus.

title: Coderium V2
description: A full rebuild of a content-publishing and knowledge-management platform for developers, moving from a legacy architecture to a modern monorepo. About 20 architecture and design docs are done, with active development using CAF from day one.

title: AI Clipper CLI
description: An open-source Python tool that automatically turns long YouTube videos into viral, ready-to-post clips — download, Whisper transcription, viral segment detection with Gemini, and auto-editing with face-tracking and "Hormozi"-style subtitles.

title: Content Automation System (Notion + Hermes)
description: An end-to-end pipeline that automates content creation — from idea to a ready-to-post carousel visual — for the @ganjar_hadiatna personal brand. Notion acts as memory, a Hermes agent on a VPS connected to Telegram acts as the operator, and a custom pipeline renders carousels automatically from drafts, complete with automatic scoring based on a 100-point rubric.
